text.lead: Black Magic for White Boys is a 2017 American comedy film written by, directed by and starring Onur Tukel. The film premiered at the 2017 Tribeca TV portion of the Tribeca Film Festival.
text.cast:
- Ronald Guttman as Larry
- Onur Tukel as Oscar
- Charlie LaRose as Chase
- Tavares Jamal Cherry as Bryson
- Eva Dorrepaal as Lucy
- Colin Buckingham as Dean
- Franck Raharinosy as Fred
- Matt Hopkins as Carl at Systems Tech (voice)
- Brendan Miller as Ralphie
- Kevin Corrigan
text.reception: The film has an 88% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, based on eight reviews with an average rating of 6.33/10.
